get.summary:
Lists every AI agent discovered for the authenticated tenant, with rollups derived on read: device
count, current posture score, current risk score/level, and business-purpose classification (D26).
Returns an empty array if the tenant has no discovered agents yet — never a 404.

Retrieves full detail for one discovered agent: its tools, skills, every device it was found on
(each fully expanded), its business-purpose classification, and its current risk/posture scores.

Returns the vulnerabilities found on the agent's current posture-analysis run, joined to the
vulnerability catalog. Served separately from M:Mine.Portal.Module.AispmAgentsDemo.Api.PublicApi.AispmPublicAgentsController.GetAgentSignals(System.Guid,System.Threading.CancellationToken) — the two risk-factor
collections are never unioned (D35). If the agent has no completed posture run yet, returns an
empty list with null run/score fields rather than a 404.

Returns the governance signals from the agent's current insights run — the second, separately
served risk-factor collection (never unioned with vulnerabilities, D35). If the agent has no
completed insights run yet, returns an empty list with null run/score fields rather than a 404.

Lists every device discovered for the authenticated tenant, including every device column plus the
scanner version from its last scan run. Returns an empty array if the tenant has no discovered
devices yet — never a 404.

Retrieves full detail for one device: every device column plus every agent found on it, each fully
expanded (tools, skills, business purpose, posture analysis run summary, and both risk-factor
collections — vulnerabilities and signals, never unioned, D35).

post.description:
Creating an account results in an invite being sent to the email address in the request.
            If the company already has an account, the request will be denied.

200.description: Returns the newly created account ID

400.description: The request contains an invalid parameter

401.description: The request is not authenticated properly

409.description: The domain already has a company assigned to it

get.description: A partner can only get information for accounts he is allowed to. Partners are automatically allowed to account created by them.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The ID of the account to get information for

200.description: Returns the information for the account

400.description: The request contains an invalid parameter

401.description: The request is not authenticated properly

403.description: The partner is not authorized to access the account ID or it does not exist

userEmail.description:
Email address of the first user to have access to the new account.
the email address provided must be a business account (not a free domain like gmail/outlook/...)

companyName.description: Name of the company for which the account is created.

cmpProductId.description: Optional: If the customer for which the account is being created has a CMP solution, insert its product ID here so it will be linked from the platform. If you are not sure the product ID of you CMP solution, reach out to us.

domains.description: A list of website domains that are used by the customer for which the account is being created. At least one is required.

accountId.description: Account ID of the newly created account.

purpose.description: The classified business purpose (e.g. "customer support automation").

explanation.description: A short explanation of why this purpose was assigned.

insightsRunId.description: The insights run that produced this classification, if any.

AgentBusinessPurposeDto.description: Business-purpose classification as a full object (source: AgentBusinessPurpose, 1:1 with Agent).

displayName.description: The agent's display name, if known.

applicationType.description: The kind of application this agent runs as (e.g. browser extension, CLI tool, IDE plugin).

findingType.description: How this agent was found (e.g. process scan, browser extension inventory).

llms.description: The LLM providers/models this agent is known to call.

vendorId.description: The vendor this agent is attributed to, if resolved.

deviceCount.description: The number of devices this agent is currently present on (derived, not stored).

firstSeenAt.description: The earliest time this agent was seen on any device.

lastSeenAt.description: The most recent time this agent was seen on any device.

postureScore.description: The agent's current posture score, or null if it has no completed posture run yet.

riskScore.description: The agent's current risk score, or null if it has no completed insights run yet.

riskLevel.description: The agent's current risk level (derived from Mine.Portal.Module.AispmAgentsDemo.Api.PublicApi.AgentListItemDto.RiskScore), or null.

definitionSummary.description: A short, human-readable summary of what this agent's definition does.

definitionExcerpt.description: A redacted excerpt of the agent's raw definition (see the P13 redaction contract).

builtinCapabilities.description: Built-in capability flags this agent's definition declares.

tools.description: The tools this agent is configured with.

skills.description: The skills this agent is configured with.

devices.description: Every device this agent has been found on, each with its finding-specific state.

AgentDetailDto.description:
Full detail for one discovered agent, extending the list-item fields with tools/skills/devices.
Note: the inherited Mine.Portal.Module.AispmAgentsDemo.Api.PublicApi.AgentListItemDto.FirstSeenAt/Mine.Portal.Module.AispmAgentsDemo.Api.PublicApi.AgentListItemDto.LastSeenAt
are not populated here (they're a list-endpoint rollup only) — per-device timing is available via
each element of Mine.Portal.Module.AispmAgentsDemo.Api.PublicApi.AgentDetailDto.Devices.
